name: Hidden Syndicates
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Gloom-Mist
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, the first time they are attacked each round, enemy units attacking them get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Ambush Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -2" range to a min. of 6" when charging it.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Counter in melee.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Gloom-Mist
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Gloom-Mist, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Gloom-Mist (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Demolish
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Rending when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Rending when shooting.

specialRules.name: Slayer Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Screened
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, the first time they are attacked each round, enemy units attacking them get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Screened
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Screened, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Screened (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Rending
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).
